scope: Public-source research informs broad visual context, not reproductions. No identity text, seal, barcode, emblem or portrait is generated.

entities.observations: Downloaded and visually inspected public renewal-page screenshot containing SEAFI banner and small sample card: white field, green/cyan loop ornament at right and green lower flourishes; dark burgundy footer.
entities.limitations: Indirect third-party screenshot, small card and issue year unclear. No fine-pattern accuracy asserted. Pass04 adds original green loop ornament and whitens field; arcade remains geographic invention.

entities.observations: 2019 news report establishes a redesign; not a resolved physical-card image. Image searches returned promotional requirements and digital-phone artwork.
entities.limitations: Canyon and river original geographic invention; no claim of specimen match. Follow-up physical-card article download returned HTTP 403; official security-release page supplied text only. Digital promotion not treated as physical specimen.

entities.observations: Official validation page search result contains image placeholders; direct open timed out.
entities.limitations: Pacific palms and coast are geographic invention; municipal and temporal variants unresolved. Follow-up official validation fetch returned HTTP 503; other reachable news supplied administrative text or staff photography, not a resolved card.

entities.observations: Directly inspected PDF page 1 screenshot: pale gray patterned field, rose/lilac/green decorative region, broad light center and lower foliage/ornamental shapes.
entities.limitations: 2024 procurement specimen; original flowers and stepped fretwork reinterpret broad color and decoration only.

entities.observations: Downloaded and visually inspected full official 2017 chofer sample: golden sky, turquoise lower stripe and a yellow angular decorative corner; dark cultural sculpture silhouettes at right.
entities.limitations: Historic 2017 version only. Pass04 uses pale gold/turquoise and original stepped linework; coral remains geographic invention, no source sculpture copied.

entities.observations: Directly inspected page 54 screenshot: muted gray field with fine pale diagonal curves; white central space, restrained green/orange accent strips.
entities.limitations: 2015 historic specimen only; water plants and green botanical field are geographic invention.

entities.observations: Downloaded and visually inspected Milenio launch photograph: card is small but visibly white/lilac with burgundy curved lower-right accent.
entities.limitations: Card is about 100 pixels wide in press photograph; only broad color placement reliable. Pass04 adds original pale burgundy corner ribbons; hill and grasses remain invented.

entities.observations: Downloaded official manual and rendered page 36: vertical demonstration card uses broad white-to-gray field, light gray bars and restrained gray header.
entities.limitations: Historic 2017 identity-guideline mock-up, not current card or resolved fine linework. Pass04 makes background more neutral gray; maritime tower remains geographic invention.

entities.observations: Image search returned green-tinted card photograph, hand-held; search image metadata describes green field.
entities.limitations: Low-resolution thumbnail evidence only; no microscopic pattern claim. Stepped structure and foliage invented. Direct image download and alternative base URL returned HTTP403/XML. Web image metadata alone not counted as inspection.

entities.observations: Downloaded and visually inspected: cartoon person, generic gray placeholder bars, tricolor blocks. Rejected as meaningful specimen evidence.
entities.limitations: Public article illustration is not a genuine specimen; original rose architecture retained; current specimen unresolved.

visual_coverage.note: Six usable visual references; dated, small-photo and mock-up limitations remain explicit per entity. No assertion of current licence replication.
